context: Sakura shows Yumiko a TV interview from a famous program.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お母さん、テレビ番組、出演、決まった。
lines.en: Mom — I got cast in a TV show.
lines.style: Bright but grounded announcement. Opening with quiet pride, not performance. Warm exhale beneath the words. Pace measured to let the news land. Genuine, not seeking validation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Sharp intake of breath on the first word — genuine surprise and delight. Then settles into warm maternal certainty. Voice lifts but doesn't perform. The real thing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to seeing it.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Eyes inward for a moment. Speaking more to herself than performing. Genuine wonder at her own work. Slight warmth at the edges.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: The whole family will absolutely watch it together.
lines.style: Certain and grounded. Not a performance of certainty — the quiet kind that comes from knowing her family. Warm resolve. A promise made gently.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'm so grateful to all of you — to our family.
lines.style: Tender, real gratitude without performing it. Slight catch in the voice without breaking. The words cost her something to say. Silence held after the final word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 一緒に、ここまで、本当、宝。
lines.en: Getting here with you all — that's been the real treasure.
lines.style: Quiet, philosophical. Speaking from a place of actual reflection. Not rushed. The voice carries the weight of years compressed into one sentence. Maternal and true.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Every day with you has been good.
lines.style: Simple, unadorned. No flourish. Warm and present. The kind of thing that lingers because it's said with such quietness and truth. Slight fadeout at the end, like settling.
